audit.why: Swain favored all 7 stages per packet levelChart and content win[] — poke range and drain-tank sustain beat Poppy's melee engage kit the whole way, consistent throughout.

Spikes at lvl2 (Q+E chunk vs her dash-only W), lvl6 (R drain-heals through her single-target stun), 1st item (Liandry's + P pull out-damages her no-sustain kit), late (AoE drain tank vs single-target peel) are grounded.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flagged two real interactions absent from the page: Poppy's R (Keeper's Verdict) grants untargetability through the channel, and her P (Iron Ambassador) buckler pickup shields her — neither was mentioned anywhere in dosFull/dontsFull.

audit.corrected: Folded both into dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d (which also had copy-paste-bleed to fix).
